comment: Kid/ Teen Fantasy Graphic Novel series: MC has long pink hair and is either in middle school or high school. She has a crush on this guy who has a magical secret. Read around 2009-2014. Spoiler.. I read this book around 2010-2014 so I don't remember that many details anymore and some physical descriptions of characters may be wrong. SPOILERS: I remember that the MC finds out that the boy's secret is that he is originally from a book or something where he was a very minor side character so he chooses to leave. I believe he was a cat in that book/other world. There is also another female character who is considered a popular girl in school but is originally also from the same world as the boy. In that other book world, she was also a background character.
